phases.name: Year 1
phases.subtitle: Explore
phases.description: Engineering & Quantitative Foundations — Build STEM literacy, explore ISE careers, and develop systems thinking.

milestones.label: Explore industrial and systems engineering career pathways
milestones.description: Introduction to engineering disciplines with emphasis on ISE applications in manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, supply chain, quality, and human factors engineering.

milestones.label: Build calculus foundations for engineering
milestones.description: Functions, limits, derivatives, and integration. Mathematical foundation for optimization, probability, and operations research.

milestones.label: Master general chemistry for engineers
milestones.description: Atomic structure, chemical bonding, stoichiometry, and thermochemistry. Foundation for materials science and manufacturing processes.

milestones.label: Join IISE student chapter
milestones.description: Join the Institute of Industrial and Systems Engineers (IISE) student chapter, NSBE, or SWE. Participate in lean manufacturing simulations, facility tours, and process improvement workshops.

milestones.label: Study physics foundations for engineering
milestones.description: Mechanics, thermodynamics, and waves. Foundation for manufacturing processes, ergonomics, and facility design.

phases.name: Year 2
phases.subtitle: Engage
phases.description: Core ISE Sciences — Master probability, statistics, and manufacturing processes.

milestones.label: Master engineering probability and statistics
milestones.description: Probability theory, statistical distributions, hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, and regression analysis. Foundation for quality control, reliability, and simulation.

milestones.label: Study manufacturing processes and systems
milestones.description: Machining, forming, casting, welding, additive manufacturing, and CNC programming. Students operate manufacturing equipment and design production processes.

milestones.label: Tour manufacturing facilities and logistics centers
milestones.description: Visit regional manufacturing plants, automotive facilities, and distribution centers with IISE chapter. Observe lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, and automation in practice.

milestones.label: Master operations research and optimization
milestones.description: Linear programming, integer programming, network optimization, and sensitivity analysis using CPLEX or Gurobi. Students solve real optimization problems in logistics, scheduling, and resource allocation.

milestones.label: Study work systems and human factors
milestones.description: Ergonomics, workplace design, cognitive engineering, and human-machine interaction. Students conduct ergonomic assessments and design workstations meeting OSHA standards.

phases.name: Year 3
phases.subtitle: Develop
phases.description: Advanced ISE & Professional Experience — Master quality, simulation, and complete internship.

milestones.label: Master quality engineering and Six Sigma
milestones.description: Statistical process control, design of experiments, Six Sigma DMAIC methodology, and reliability analysis. Students earn Six Sigma Green Belt certification through coursework.

milestones.label: Study simulation modeling and analysis
milestones.description: Discrete-event simulation using Arena or Simio. Students model manufacturing systems, healthcare operations, and logistics networks to analyze performance and recommend improvements.

milestones.label: Compete in IISE case competition or lean challenge
milestones.description: Participate in IISE regional case competition or lean manufacturing challenge. Apply ISE tools to solve real operational problems in a competitive team environment.

milestones.label: Complete summer ISE internship
milestones.description: Secure and complete an internship in manufacturing engineering, process improvement, supply chain, or healthcare operations. Apply ISE tools and methodologies professionally.

milestones.label: Study supply chain and logistics engineering
milestones.description: Quantitative supply chain modeling, inventory optimization, facility location, and logistics network design. Students optimize global supply chain configurations.

phases.name: Year 4
phases.subtitle: Launch
phases.description: Capstone Design & Career Launch — Complete senior design project, earn certifications, and launch ISE career.

milestones.label: Execute senior design capstone project
milestones.description: Complete a year-long systems engineering project with an industry sponsor. Teams apply ISE tools to improve manufacturing, healthcare, or logistics operations and present recommendations.

milestones.label: Prepare for FE exam and Lean Six Sigma certification
milestones.description: Prepare for the NCEES FE Industrial & Systems exam and finalize Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt certification. Build professional credentials for career launch.

milestones.label: Serve as peer mentor and IISE chapter leader
milestones.description: Mentor underclassmen in ISE coursework, lead IISE chapter activities, and organize lean simulations, facility tours, and career panels.

milestones.label: Develop career placement portfolio
milestones.description: Assemble a career launch package including technical resume, project portfolio, Six Sigma certification, FE exam status, and documented professional network.

milestones.label: Complete exit assessment and career activation
milestones.description: Complete the CoE ISE Exit Assessment demonstrating ABET outcomes. Finalize career activation documenting job offers, graduate admissions, or certification achievements.
